notes: Menu: pickup prices from the chain's own ordering site (order.littlecaesars.com, store menu data from onlo-api.littlecaesars.com/bff/menu) at three stores, found by carryout search for each City Hall address. NY: store 21025, 822 Broadway, Brooklyn NY 11206 (the search for City Hall Park returned this store first; no Manhattan store was listed). IL: store 12392, 850 W Superior St, Chicago IL 60642 (the search for 60602 returned this store first). AZ: store 1350, 933 16th St, Phoenix AZ 85006 (search for 85003 returned this store first). Item names: pizza size is the menu group 'Large Round Pizzas'; Crazy Bread count is not shown on the site so no count is in the name. Caesar Wings omitted: priced per flavour choice and the store prices differ too much to compare. Two of the three stores showed isOpen/isOrderable false at the time of capture (2026-11-12); menu prices were still displayed. Deal: none recorded. Site offers are percent-off codes (TOUCHDOWN 15% off $15+, DELIVERY20 20% off delivery $25+), not per-item prices, and the 'More For $X' menu bundles have no direct-only terms found. Direct delivery: false. Delivery is available at all three addresses (store finder and delivery-store API), and the cart shows 'Delivery fee and a service fee (max $4.00) apply' with no dollar delivery fee before checkout. Checkout needs personal details, so the fee was not read (ISS-025). Platforms: 2020 and 2023 press only; the Little Caesars site does not list apps. No Grubhub evidence found. Markup: no chain-specific published figure found, so category default (est). Sources checked 2026-11-12.
